capabilities: prototype: read-only local inventory of regular files with SHA-256 digests
prototype: explicit initialization of an empty, non-system, operator-owned sandbox root
prototype: regular single-link file quarantine inside an initialized sandbox
prototype: pre-change rollback snapshot and versioned SHA-256-bound plan
prototype: exact typed operator approval bound to the plan hash
prototype: separate apply, verify, and outcome-record stages
prototype: separately approved restore from the pre-change snapshot with quarantine evidence retained
not implemented: process termination or service control
not implemented: firewall, routing, socket, or interface mutation
not implemented: privilege escalation or remote host operations
negative_scope: outbound scanning (except explicitly authorized bounded artifact retrieval in cas-threat-index)
fabricated or simulated live operational evidence

platforms.notes: CI matrix passed all unit tests and schema checks on Ubuntu 24.04 for Python 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13.

platforms.target: Other POSIX-compatible operating systems and filesystems
platforms.notes: Not tested. No cross-platform or filesystem compatibility claim is made.
